title: UE radio capability ID availability IE

entities.name: UE radio capability ID availability IE
entities.description: Information element indicating availability of UE radio capability ID. Included by UE in WB-S1 mode when supporting RACS and having applicable UE radio capability ID for current radio configuration in selected PLMN.

entities.name: WB-S1 mode condition
entities.description: Condition that UE is operating in WB-S1 mode.

entities.name: RACS support condition
entities.description: Condition that UE supports RACS (Radio Access Capability Signaling).

entities.name: Applicable UE radio capability ID condition
entities.description: Condition that UE has applicable UE radio capability ID for current UE radio configuration in selected PLMN.

relations.description: UE radio capability ID availability IE inclusion is guarded by WB-S1 mode condition.
UE radio capability ID availability IE inclusion is guarded by RACS support condition.
UE radio capability ID availability IE inclusion is guarded by applicable UE radio capability ID condition.
